title: Wiser pricing - Order-volume tiered, free to $49/month
clean_text: Wiser offers a free plan for development stores, with paid plans starting at $9 per month for stores with up to 100 orders. Pricing scales with order volume: $19 per month for 101-300 orders, and $49 per month for 301-500 orders. Each tier includes AI recommendations and analytics features without feature gating, with cost scaling purely by order volume rather than feature access.
